notes.title: Update 1.0i
notes.content:
[h3]⚖️ BALANCE CHANGES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Greataxe skill is now doing damage based on unused capacity on given die => +1 damage per unused capacity.
[*] Decay skill is now inflicting Weak and Vulnerable based on unused capacity on given die => +1 Weak and +1 Vulnerable per 3 unused capacity.
[/list]

[h3]✨ IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Modifiers selection is now persistent between runs.
[*] Descriptions of Feather, Thunderstorm and Chain Lightning updated to more reflect skills and relic effects.
[*] Whetstone description updated to reflect, that Whetstone does not work with ultimate skill.
[*] Jumping via Portal now shows quick teleport loading screen.
[/list]

[h3]🛠️ FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unstable Energy in upgraded version is fixed.
[*] Issue with possible Bratwurst abuse when visiting Merchant is fixed.
[*] Multiple bugs in all translations are fixed.
[*] Dialogues in Russian language are fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: The Future of Luck & Loot: Roadmap Revealed!

notes.title: Luck & Loot Launches July 22 – Forge Your Dice, Face the Darkness
notes.content:
[h1]🎲 [i]Luck & Loot [/i]Launches July 22[/h1]

[h3][b]Full Release – July 22, 2025 – 12:00 PM EST | 6:00 PM CEST[/b][/h3]

Step into the cursed kingdom of Eldralith in Luck & Loot, a tactical roguelike where [b]dice don’t just decide your fate—they define it.[/b] After months of development and refinement, we're thrilled to announce the full release of [i]Luck & Loot[/i] on PC.


[h2]▶️ Watch the Trailer[/h2]

[previewyoutube=0ZSKIkspAjE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]💀 What Awaits You[/h2]

Strategic dice-based combat meets dark fantasy storytelling in a world gripped by illusion, corruption, and impossible odds.

[b]Build your dice. Choose your hero. Survive the loop.[/b]

[b]Features at Full Launch:[/b]
[list]

[*] 🎲 [b]80+ Dice Faces[/b] — Craft your perfect build from interchangeable, upgradeable faces.

[*] 🧙 [b]3 Unique Heroes[/b] — Tirnaya, Isucor, and Ravenhardt each bring their own dice and despair.

[*] 🐉 [b]5 Procedurally Generated Dungeons[/b] — Each ruled by a devastating boss with distinct mechanics.

[*] 📜 [b]40+ Relics & 36+ Events[/b] — Discover secrets, curses, and rare synergies across your runs.

[*] 🔥 [b]16+ Difficulty Modifiers[/b] — Turn the dial up. But beware: power always comes at a price.

[*] ☠️ [b]40+ Enemy Types & Bosses[/b] — From fungal monstrosities to vampiric knights and whispering horrors.
[/list]
[h2]👁 A World That Wants You to Lose[/h2]

[i]Luck & Loot[/i] is built to challenge. [b]Expect to fall[/b]. To falter. To [b]roll, curse, reroll—and try again[/b].

Every death feeds the cycle. Every failure whispers truth. As an unknown interloper might say:

[i]“You moved the pieces so carefully… How many times did he die for you?”[/i]


[h2]📜 Wishlist & Survive[/h2]

This is a game [b]for players who love to experiment[/b], to [b]lose with style[/b], and to learn the rhythm of [b]a world that doesn't want you to win[/b]. If that sounds like you:


[h3][b]👉 Wishlist now

👉 Challenge fate, July 22nd[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Luck & Loot - Limited Access Beta!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Heroes, scavengers, and wanderers of Eldralith—[/b][/h3]

The loop tightens. The gates of the Dark Keep draw near. And with it, a chance to help shape the future of Luck & Loot.

We’re kicking off our Closed Beta this week with a limited number of keys available.
To opt in, join our Discord and let us know that you're interested—we’ll add you to the private beta channel from there.

[h2]🎲 [url=https://discord.gg/xDMpTMXnqd]Join the Beta on Discord[/url][/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258162/5ce812f6eaf3f65d7aad5b3c73f45b807e2106d0.gif[/img]

[h1]🎨 VISUAL & AUDIO DESIGN[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]New Color Palettes[/b] – You can now customize the look of your run. Whether you're feeling bleak, bold, or something in between, pick the palette that fits. (See gif above)

[*] [b]Original Soundtrack Complete[/b] – The full soundtrack is now in-game, with haunting themes to match every ruin, ritual, and revelation.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258162/5a80b6a6951770ae7769aa32be4624e78ce30738.png[/img]
[h1]🧟‍♂️ ENEMIES & BOSSES[/h1]

New threats have entered the cycle:

[list]
[*] [b]Ghor'Mar, the two-headed giant in the Ruins[/b]—one head lives for battle, the other lives for fashion. They don’t always agree, but they both want you dead.

[*] [b]Karnach, the Houndmaster[/b], guards the Dark Keep with quiet fury—and a very real, very cursed beast.

[*] [b]Maelor, the fallen king[/b], awaits in the heart of the Keep. But to face him, you’ll need to prove you’re ready.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258162/98e21d265079f364d0df53aca6ec8cc9e14aa0df.png[/img]
[h1]🧩 GAMEPLAY & MECHANICS[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Ultimate Ability Tree[/b] – Each hero now has a unique upgrade path. Shape your style.

[*] [b]Dungeon Traits[/b] – Dungeons now have distinct challenges: more floors, tougher enemies, better loot. Survive 3 of 4 to reach the Dark Keep.

[*] [b]Difficulty Modifiers[/b] – After your first win, unlock new ways to challenge yourself and raise your score.

[*] [b]Maelor's Vial [/b]– He only appears if you’ve stacked enough modifiers.

[*] [b]New Skills & Dice Traits [/b]– Tons of new build options to explore. Try new synergies and break the cycle your way.
[/list]

[h1]🏰 NARRATIVE & PROGRESSION[/h1]

[b]Fully Implemented Dialogue System[/b] – Win runs to reveal more about each hero. Their pasts, their regrets, their place in the cycle.

New Events –

[list]
[*] [b]Duelist[/b] – fight for glory

[*] [b]Coffin & Gallows[/b] – bargain with your soul

[*] [b]Grinding Wheel, Goblifly, Bird Event, Wall of the Dead [/b]– sometimes survival pairs with strange encounters
[/list]

[h1]📅 WHAT’S NEXT?[/h1]

[b]🧪 Closed Beta: Live This Week (Limited Keys)

 🗓️ Full Launch: June 2025[/b]

The world isn’t whole. The cycle hasn’t ended. But we’re getting close.

Sharpen your will. Take a breath. And when you're ready—

[h3][b]Roll the dice.[/b][/h3]

notes.title: The Cycle Turns—Next Fest Recap & Closed Beta Incoming!
